cypher_match_plus.q: MATCH (a:I54XC055837) MATCH (a)-[:KX055837]->(b) WHERE b.v = a.v + 1 RETURN a.name, b.name ORDER BY a.name
cypher_match_plus.sql:
SELECT Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(%EXACT(p6.val)) AS a_name, Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(%EXACT(p7.val)) AS b_name
FROM Graph_KG.nodes n0
JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND l1.label = ?
JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_edges e3 ON e3.s = n0.node_id AND e3.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND e3.p = ?
JOIN Graph_KG.nodes n2 ON n2.node_id = e3.o_id AND n2.graph_id = e3.graph_id
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p4 ON p4.s = n2.node_id AND p4.graph_id = n2.graph_id AND p4."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p5 ON p5.s = n0.node_id AND p5.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p5."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p6 ON p6.s = n0.node_id AND p6.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p6."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p7 ON p7.s = n2.node_id AND p7.graph_id = n2.graph_id AND p7."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p8 ON p8.s = n0.node_id AND p8.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p8."key" = ?
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Graph_KG.rdf_props _sgn2 WHERE _sgn2.s = n2.node_id AND _sgn2.graph_id = n2.graph_id AND _sgn2."key" = 'v') AND l1.s IS NOT NULL AND p4.val = (CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(p5.val) = 0 THEN COALESCE(Graph_KG.CY_ARITH(p5.val, '+', 1), NULL) ELSE (CAST(p5.val AS DOUBLE) + 1) END)

cypher_with_after_plus.q: MATCH (a:I54XC055837) OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[:KX055837]->(b) WITH a, b WHERE b.v = a.v + 1 RETURN a.name, b.name ORDER BY a.name
cypher_with_after_plus.sql:
WITH Stage1 AS (
SELECT n0.node_id AS a, n2.node_id AS b, n0.graph_id AS __g_a, n2.graph_id AS __g_b
FROM Graph_KG.nodes n0
JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_labels l1 ON l1.s = n0.node_id AND l1.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND l1.label = ?
LEFT OUTER JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_edges e3 ON e3.s = n0.node_id AND e3.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND e3.p = ?
LEFT OUTER JOIN Graph_KG.nodes n2 ON n2.node_id = e3.o_id AND n2.graph_id = e3.graph_id
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p4 ON p4.s = n0.node_id AND p4.graph_id = n0.graph_id AND p4."key" = ?
WHERE l1.s IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT val FROM Graph_KG.rdf_props WHERE s = n2.node_id AND graph_id = n2.graph_id AND "key" = ?) = CASE WHEN ISNUMERIC(p4.val) = 0 THEN COALESCE(Graph_KG.CY_ARITH(p4.val, '+', 1), NULL) ELSE (CAST(p4.val AS DOUBLE) + 1) END
)
SELECT Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(%EXACT(p5.val)) AS a_name, Graph_KG.CY_TYPED(%EXACT(p6.val)) AS b_name
FROM Stage1 Stage1
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p5 ON p5.s = a AND p5.graph_id = Stage1.__g_a AND p5."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p6 ON p6.s = b AND p6.graph_id = Stage1.__g_b AND p6."key" = ?
LEFT JOIN Graph_KG.rdf_props p7 ON p7.s = a AND p7.graph_id = Stage1.__g_a AND p7."key" = ?
ORDER BY %EXACT(Graph_KG.CY_SORT_KEY(p7.val, 'x')) ASC
